html:
/* RecipeBox layout. Where the box sits (float parameter) is set inline by Template:RecipeBox,
   this page only adds a minimum width and the phone layout. */
.aa-recipebox {
  display: flow-root;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 320px; /* never squeezed narrower than this, also inside a row of boxes */
  min-width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 2rem)); /* on very small screens: the screen width */
  flex: 0 0 auto;   /* a flex row (like display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap) wraps the box instead of shrinking it */
}
.aa-recipebox table.wikitable {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 100%;
}

/* Phones: a floated box gets its own line instead of squeezing the text */
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .aa-recipebox-float {
    float: none !important;
    clear: both !important;
    margin: 0.5em 0 !important;
  }
}

/* The recipe card (same look as the item, skill and buff cards) */
.aa-rb {
  width: 320px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.97), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.97));
  border: 1px solid #5a5040;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  color: #e8e4d8;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: left;
}
.aa-rb-head {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
/* the product: icon + title (hover = the card of the item) */
.aa-rb-prod {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  min-width: 0;
}
.aa-rb-icon {
  flex: none;
  line-height: 0;
}
.aa-rb-title {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.aa-rb-kind,
.aa-rb-grade {
  color: #8a8478;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.aa-rb-name {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
/* chance for 2x: a small tag at the right of the header */
.aa-rb-chip {
  flex: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 1px 8px;
  border: 1px solid #6a5d48;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: rgba(240, 208, 96, 0.08);
  color: #f0d060;
  font-weight: bold;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.aa-rb-chiplabel {
  color: #8a8478;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: normal;
}
.aa-rb-sep {
  height: 1px;
  margin: 10px 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #6a5d48, transparent);
}
.aa-rb-stats {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  padding-left: 40px;   /* lines the facts up with the item names below (4px row padding + 32px icon + 4px gap): change here */
}
.aa-rb-statrow {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px 28px;   /* each fact is only as wide as its text */
}
.aa-rb-label {
  color: #8a8478;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.aa-rb-mats {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.aa-rb-labor {
  color: #F8D870;   /* the light gold of the labor text in the game */
  font-weight: bold;
}
.aa-rb-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}
.aa-rb-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
  border-radius: 2px;
}
.aa-rb-row:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}
/* icon and name side by side: a long name that wraps keeps its indent to the right of the icon */
.aa-rb-item {
  flex-grow: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
.aa-rb-item .aa-itemtip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.aa-rb-item .aa-itemtip > span:first-child {
  flex: none;   /* the icon never shrinks */
}
.aa-rb-coinlabel {
  color: #c9c3b4;
}
.aa-rb-amount {
  flex: none;
  color: #c9c3b4;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.aa-rb-foot {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
}
.aa-rb-costlabel,
.aa-rb-note {
  display: block;
}
/* the Recipe Cost link keeps the normal text colour and shows no external-link icon; it underlines on hover */
.aa-rb-costlabel a,
.aa-rb-costlabel a:visited {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.aa-rb-costlabel a.external {
  background: none;
  padding-right: 0;
}
.aa-rb-costlabel a:hover {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.aa-rb-note {
  color: #8a8478;
  font-size: 11px;
}
.aa-rb-cost {
  font-weight: bold;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* the hover cards of the items open beside the row; in the card they must not be clipped */
.aa-rb .aa-itemtip-card {
  font-size: 13px;
}
/* The hover card of a material is placed against the whole row (just beyond the amount), not against the name:
   a name that wraps over two lines would otherwise push the card far away. The whole row is the hover area. */
.aa-rb-row {
  position: relative;
}
.aa-rb-item .aa-itemtip {
  position: static;
}
.aa-rb-row:hover .aa-itemtip-card {
  display: block;
}
